notes.title: Want to play before pay? Play the demo!
notes.content:
Hello all! So we've had some people experience some unintentional bugs that are being investigated as we speak! As a reminder, if there's anyone that wants to check to see if the game is for them or if it'll work on their computer, feel free to check out the demo on the website!

We apologize for not making the demo more transparent, but we hope your experience with the game will be made better!

The Sorcerer's Path Team

notes.title: We got ourselves some contests!
notes.content:
With the release of the game coming soon, contests are in order! There will be three, one for a free Art Book, one for a free Soundtrack, and one for a free copy of the game! There's only 5 chances for each, so here are the requirements for each!

Art Book

Make a piece of Fan Art of any of the characters of the game! Have fun with it! It could be from the trailer, from the concept art on this site, or even from the sprite art of the demo!

Soundtrack

Make a remix of any of the pieces of music from the game! We dare you to make a piece that's catchier then the original! Use the Soundtrack page of the website or play the demo and pick the one that sounds the most intriguing to remix to you!

Game

You know the Dark Wizard you fight in the first level of the demo? Well, if you can get his health down halfway and take a screenshot, you got yourself a free game!

In order to be eligible for any of these contests, you must post it on a social media page and link it back here as well as sending your results via the Facebook Page! Don't worry, you keep the rights of your work! It's all for good fun!

notes.title: More Fun to Come Your Way!
notes.content:
We're all incredibly happy that this page is finally up and the game is scheduled to be released soon, but there isn't gonna be just silence as we wait for March 5th! There's a Soundtrack to come, an Art Book, and maybe even some competitions to come! News will be posted here, but don't forget to go on our Facebook for more updates and check out the website! We all hope this is a wonderful experience cause finishing this game was one for us!

The Sorcerer's Path Team
